scene.location: North drainage gully off Lantern Road outside Vespergate
scene.situation: DevilMedlar questioned Nyxara Veyl while studying her for deception. Insight 14 + 1 = 15 against DC 13 succeeded. Nyxara is truthful that she was independently following the cult-mark carver and is not allied with him. She identifies the cult as the Velvet Coil and says the carver stole a ledger in Vespergate containing names connected to the cult. One name in the ledger matters personally to her, but she refuses to identify that person yet. She says the carver continued toward the old culvert.

clues.likely_carver_trail: Carver is believed to have continued along the upper shelf toward an old culvert.
clues.nyxara_truth: Her core claim that she was independently following the carver is truthful.
clues.nyxara_withholding: She is withholding the identity of someone personally important whose name appears in the stolen ledger.
clues.stolen_ledger: Nyxara says the carver stole a ledger in Vespergate containing names tied to the Velvet Coil.
clues.sunscale_shard: Still warm; not yet examined further.
